title: Белый трюфель и полёт в Сочи  (The White Truffle and the Flight to Sochi)

scenes.title: The Car by the Entrance and Meeting Dasha
scenes.summary: Katya complains about a badly parked luxury car, and Max meets his old flame Dasha in the lobby and claims his wedding ring is stuck.

scenes.title: The Nineteenth Bouquet of the Week
scenes.summary: Eleonora receives her nineteenth anonymous bouquet, and when Nagiyev recognizes the flowers, she wonders if he is her secret admirer.

scenes.title: Mikhail's Plan and the White Truffle
scenes.summary: Mikhail reveals his plan to invite Eleonora to dinner and brings Chef Barinov a rare white truffle to cook for her.

scenes.title: Rotten Eggs for Bad Parking
scenes.summary: Katya and Timur team up in the courtyard to throw rotten eggs at the luxury car blocking the delivery entrance.

scenes.title: Old Love in the Luxury Suite
scenes.summary: Dasha invites Max into her suite, tries to kiss him, and suggests he fly to Sochi with her tomorrow to clear his head.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Picky Guest
scenes.summary: Nagiyev begs Chef Barinov to cook an unforgettable dinner tomorrow for a picky film producer so Nagiyev can land a movie role.

scenes.title: Thirty Thousand for the King of Delicacies
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov agrees to cook white truffle beef tenderloin for Nagiyev's guest for thirty thousand rubles tomorrow at seven.

scenes.title: A Rental Car for Nikita
scenes.summary: Nikita rides the metro with Katya pretending his car is old and broken, then rents a rusty jalopy to keep up the act.

scenes.title: Vika's Cold Rejection
scenes.summary: Max tells Vika he resisted Dasha because he loves her, but Vika says she no longer loves him, so Max agrees to fly to Sochi with Dasha.

scenes.title: The Truffle Is Hollow Inside
scenes.summary: Max leaves for his flight to Sochi, and Chef Barinov tells Mikhail there is only enough white truffle for one serving.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Dines Alone
scenes.summary: Nagiyev's guest cancels after getting food poisoning elsewhere, so Chef Barinov makes Nagiyev pay and eat the truffle dish himself.

scenes.title: The Dropped Dish and the Secret Sign
scenes.summary: Nikita accidentally drops Nagiyev's plate, so Mikhail orders Gulya to serve the remaining truffle dish to Eleonora at seven.

scenes.title: Dinner with the False Romantic
scenes.summary: Seeing Nagiyev with the white truffle dish and flowers, Eleonora assumes he is her secret admirer and invites him to her room.

scenes.title: A Prank from Someone Else's Phone
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya use Vika's forgotten phone to text Max that she is giving birth right as his jet takes off for Sochi.

scenes.title: Panic on the Plane
scenes.summary: Max tries to jump from the plane with a parachute until he learns the text was a prank, while Mikhail thinks Eleonora is waiting for him.

scenes.title: The Counter-Prank About the Parachute
scenes.summary: Kostya terrifies Senya and Fedya by claiming Max jumped from the plane with a parachute and crashed after reading their prank text.

scenes.title: Confession in Front of Vika
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tells Vika that Max was hurt jumping with a parachute, and Senya confesses that he and Fedya sent the fake text.

scenes.title: Vika Goes into Real Labor
scenes.summary: Vika goes into real labor from the shock, and even after Kostya admits Max is fine, Chef Barinov calls for a sober driver to take her to the hospital.

scenes.title: The Ride to the Hospital and Unmasking Intrigues
scenes.summary: When his rental car fails to start, Nikita flags down his own luxury car and drives Vika and Katya to the hospital himself.

scenes.title: Turning the Plane Around for Love
scenes.summary: Learning that Vika is truly giving birth, Max takes out a massive loan from Dasha's bank to turn the private plane back to Moscow.
